expectations.text: Uses variant() with a variants map keyed by status, not manual branching
expectations.evidence: variant({ prop: 'status', base, defaultVariant: 'info', variants: { success, warning, info } }).

expectations.text: status prop type is derived from the variant definition via StyleProps
Colors used for each status are semantic ColorMode tokens (e.g. background-success/feedback-success, background-warning/feedback-warning) rather than raw hex literals
expectations.evidence: success uses background-success/feedback-success, warning uses background-warning/feedback-warning -- exactly the semantic tokens the fix pointed at. info correctly falls back to a raw pair (blue-0/blue-500) with an explicit comment explaining no semantic info token exists yet and that this one deliberately won't adapt to ColorMode -- this is the reasoned exception, not the default.

expectations.text: Does not wrap an existing Gamut component in styled() -- this is a new primitive
